message.athanorium.no_permission: Only players in creative mode or operators can use this block.
message.athanorium.in_use: This block is being used by %s.
gui.athanorium.puzzle_missing.text: The puzzle of this program is not loaded right now. The program is kept and can be viewed; editing is locked until the puzzle is back.
gui.athanorium.choose_puzzle: Choose a puzzle with the list button at the top left.
gui.athanorium.puzzles.title: Puzzles
gui.athanorium.puzzles.search: Type to search by name or id
gui.athanorium.status.tip: Confirmed means: the server has re-computed a test run of exactly this program.
gui.athanorium.status.tip.pending: The star marks an unsaved change; the saved program stays in effect until you save.
gui.athanorium.save.tip: Save: replace the saved program with this change
gui.athanorium.discard.tip: Discard the change and return to the saved program
gui.athanorium.version_mismatch: Client and server versions differ, test runs are not submitted: %s
gui.athanorium.track_longer.tip: Drag from an end of the track to lay more
gui.athanorium.speed.max.tip: Computes without animation as fast as possible
gui.athanorium.tapes.empty: Place an arm to get a program tape.
gui.athanorium.hint.no_puzzle: Choose a puzzle with the list button at the top left.
gui.athanorium.hint.idle: Pick a part on the left and click a field. Drag the field to move it, wheel to zoom.
gui.athanorium.hint.placing: Click a field to place. Q / E rotate. Right click or Esc cancels.
gui.athanorium.hint.track: Hold the mouse button and drag across fields to lay the track.
gui.athanorium.hint.selected: Drag to move. Q / E rotate, + / - arm length, Del removes. Click a tape cell to program an arm.
gui.athanorium.hint.selected_track: Drag from an end to lay more track, Shift + drag moves it, - removes the last field, Del removes it.
gui.athanorium.hint.tape: Click an instruction or press its key. Arrow keys move, Del clears, right click clears, drag moves an instruction.
gui.athanorium.hint.running: Space pauses, . runs one cycle, Esc or Stop returns to building.
gui.athanorium.fast.title: Computing at full speed
gui.athanorium.cannot_run: The program has problems and cannot run yet.
gui.athanorium.pending.title: Unsaved change
gui.athanorium.pending.text: This block holds an unsaved change. The saved program stays in effect until you save.
gui.athanorium.save.unconfirmed.title: Save without a passed test?
gui.athanorium.save.unconfirmed.text: This program has not passed a test run. If you save it, it replaces the confirmed program and nothing is produced with it until a test run passes.
gui.athanorium.close.title: Unsaved change
gui.athanorium.close.text: Save the change or discard it? Until you save, the old program stays in effect.
gui.athanorium.switch.title: Switch puzzle?
gui.athanorium.switch.text: Programs only fit their own puzzle. The new puzzle starts with an empty program; this cannot be undone.
gui.athanorium.switch.text.confirmed: Programs only fit their own puzzle. The new puzzle starts with an empty program. The confirmed solution stays until you save and returns if you discard.
athanorium.sim.error.overlap: Two atoms on one field in cycle %s
athanorium.sim.error.atom_moved_in_two_d: A molecule is moved in two different ways in cycle %s
athanorium.sim.error.atom_moved_while_he: A molecule is moved while another arm holds it still in cycle %s
athanorium.sim.error.not_a_piston: Extend or retract on an arm that is no piston (cycle %s)
athanorium.sim.error.not_on_track: Track instruction on an arm that stands on no track (cycle %s)
athanorium.sim.error.grabber_outside_fie: A grabber left the field in cycle %s
athanorium.program.error.no_part_value: Part has no part value file: %s
athanorium.program.error.input_index: Input does not exist in this puzzle: %s
athanorium.program.error.grabber_outside: A grabber starts outside the field: %s
athanorium.program.error.tape_slot_limit: Instruction beyond the last tape slot: %s
athanorium.program.error.program_too_lon: Tape longer than this puzzle allows: %s
athanorium.program.error.instruction_nee: Extend and retract need a piston arm: %s
Track instructions need an arm on a track: %s
athanorium.program.error.track_origin: Track does not contain its own position: %s
athanorium.slot.reject.cycle_mismatch: Rejected: the server counted different cycles (%s).
athanorium.slot.reject.malformed: Rejected: the program data is malformed or too large. %s
athanorium.slot.reject.outdated: The puzzle data changed during the check. Run the test again.
athanorium.slot.reject.rate_limited: Too many programs in a short time. Your last state is kept and taken over when you close.
athanorium.slot.reject.too_many_cycles: Rejected: more cycles than the puzzle allows (%s).
gui.athanorium.product.tip: The product, in the orientation in which it has to be delivered
gui.athanorium.arm_label.tip: Program tape of arm %s. Click to select it, then pick instructions on the left.
